scenarios.title: First persistent startup spawn
scenarios.steps: Start disposable EveJS world with ALIFE-08 flag, no mining slot witness and real asteroid belt
scenarios.expected: Native original miner and hauler materialized; persistent native entity/controller/module rows and ACTIVE witness; no duplicate ship ID

scenarios.title: Second handleSceneCreated in same process
scenarios.steps: Trigger original scene callback a second time
scenarios.expected: Same two shipID values and exactly one fleet runtime record

scenarios.title: Restart before any ore mined
scenarios.steps: Cold-restart disposable world after ACTIVE slot witness flush
scenarios.expected: Same miner/hauler IDs restored; no new native allocator calls or extra fleet

scenarios.title: Restart after atomic ore commit
scenarios.steps: Mine one native asteroid cycle with ALIFE-07 flag and stop server
scenarios.expected: After restart same cargoID, ownerID, ore quantity, asteroid source and one receipt

scenarios.title: Restart after hauler pickup
scenarios.steps: Transfer source cargoID to native hauler, stop server
scenarios.expected: Same original cargoID survives in hauler; miner no longer holds original stack

scenarios.title: Restart after native warehouse COMMITTED
scenarios.steps: Unload hauler via existing #110 warehouse and restart twice
scenarios.expected: Exactly one real warehouse credit; original source and cargo trail conserved

scenarios.title: Crash after slot PREPARING
scenarios.steps: Kill disposable server after durable witness before first native spawn
scenarios.expected: Startup blocks slot NEEDS_OPERATOR_REPAIR; does not retry spawn

scenarios.title: Crash between miner/hauler spawn
scenarios.steps: Kill after native miner stored but before hauler controller stored
scenarios.expected: No automatic duplicate miner/hauler spawn after restart; original ID quarantined

scenarios.title: Crash after ACTIVE but before createFleetRecord
scenarios.steps: Terminate after ACTIVE manifest flush but before registry linkage
scenarios.expected: Reconcile existing native IDs and register one real fleet, no new spawn

scenarios.title: Destroyed NPC / wreck in active slot
scenarios.steps: Kill a persistent native miner or hauler in disposable system
scenarios.expected: Native destruction preserved; no replacement on next startup until explicit destruction policy

scenarios.title: Two clients observe recovered fleet
scenarios.steps: Connect two authorized clients after restart
scenarios.expected: Both clients observe same original physical ship IDs; no invisible duplicate NPCs

scenarios.title: Two-process and write-failure defense
scenarios.steps: Simulate stale GameStore cache and failed manifest write, then verify receipts
scenarios.expected: No fresh actor grant, no duplicate ore/cargo; flag remains OFF on live evejs-data
